tiers.note: If the diagnosis is 8 weeks or more and there is no settlement, if there are many prior violence convictions, or if a vulnerable person suffered an injury of 4 weeks or more, investigation in detention may be considered.

If the diagnosis is 4 weeks or more with no settlement, or 8 weeks or more, the case usually goes to a formal trial rather than ending with a fine. A settlement may lighten the outcome, for example to a suspended sentence.
If the victim was hardly to blame, the usual practice is a base fine of KRW 2 million plus KRW 1 million for each week beyond 2 weeks. A settlement may reduce it.
If both sides were about equally to blame, the usual practice is a base fine of KRW 1 million plus KRW 500,000 for each week beyond 2 weeks. A settlement may reduce it.
If the victim was more to blame, the usual practice is a base fine of KRW 500,000 plus KRW 300,000 for each week beyond 2 weeks.
If the victim was more to blame and the injury of 2 weeks or less came from a minor quarrel, a fine below KRW 500,000 or a suspension of indictment is also possible.

notes: The fine becomes heavier if a weapon was used, if the victim was a vulnerable person, or if there is a prior violence conviction within 1 year.
If an unexpectedly serious injury resulted, the amount is set separately instead of using the per-week calculation.
If you only defended yourself after the other person attacked first, it may count as self-defense and not be punished.

body.label: Content of the photos or videos spread

options.severe: Content causing great sexual humiliation (nudity, sexual intercourse, etc.)

options.record: Punished with a fine or heavier for a sex crime within the last 3 years

notes: Even if the person agreed to being filmed, spreading the images later without permission is punished. Spreading secretly filmed footage is treated much more heavily.

After the 2018 and 2020 amendments, the statutory penalty for this type rose sharply (previously up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 5 million), so the actual handling may be heavier than this estimate.

new-illegal-footage-possession.name: Possessing, buying, storing or viewing illegally filmed footage
new-illegal-footage-possession.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
new-illegal-footage-possession.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes, Article 14(4)

tiers.sentence: 1 year 8 months to 3 years in prison
Up to 1 year 4 months in prison

notes: This act became punishable after a 2020 amendment. Downloading, keeping or even just watching footage while knowing it was secretly filmed or spread without consent is covered.
Even with a fine, a conviction may lead to registration of personal information.

new-deepfake.name: Editing or distributing fake sexual videos (deepfakes)
new-deepfake.statutory: Editing, synthesizing, processing or distributing: up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million / Distributing online for profit: 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term (increased by up to 1/2 if habitual)

options.profit: Spread it online to make money

new-sexual-footage-threat.name: Threats or coercion using sexual footage or synthesized material
new-sexual-footage-threat.statutory: Threat: 1 year or more in prison for a fixed term / Coercion (making someone do something they have no duty to do by threat): 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term (increased by up to 1/2 if habitual)
new-sexual-footage-threat.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes, Article 14-3

options.coerce: Threatened and demanded and obtained money, videos, meetings, etc.

notes: This covers threatening to spread sexual photos, videos or deepfake material. If it was actually spread, the distribution offense is also at issue.
This crime has no fine option.

obscene-communication.name: Obscene acts using communication media
obscene-communication.statutory: Up to 2 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million
obscene-communication.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes, Article 13

options.minor: Received a suspension of indictment or a fine for the same type before
options.serious: Received a prison sentence for a sex crime, or was punished several times

tiers.note: If the offense is serious in light of repetition, the degree of obscenity, the victim's age, etc., detention is considered.
With no record, a single message or photo of low obscenity, or a minor case with a settlement, a suspension of indictment is possible, usually on conditions such as an education program.

notes: After a 2020 amendment, the statutory penalty rose sharply, so the actual handling may be heavier than this estimate.
Even with a fine, a conviction may lead to registration of personal information.

public-indecency.name: Public indecency
public-indecency.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison, a fine of up to KRW 5 million, short-term detention, or a petty fine

repeat.label: Was it repeated several times, or is there a prior conviction for the same?

p2-sexual-intrusion.name: Intrusion into a multi-use place for a sexual purpose
p2-sexual-intrusion.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million
p2-sexual-intrusion.law: Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes, Article 12

bad.label: Was it repeated, or was the act serious?

options.minor: Received a suspension of indictment or a fine for the same type before
options.serious: Received a prison sentence for a sex crime, or was punished several times

lowRisk.label: Was the risk very low given the place, method and time, or did you settle with the victim?

tiers.note: With no record and a low risk or a settlement, a suspension of indictment on conditions such as an education program is possible.

notes: This is entering a toilet, bathhouse, changing room, breastfeeding room or similar place to satisfy sexual desire, or refusing to leave when asked.
The statutory penalty has risen (previously up to 1 year in prison or a fine of up to KRW 3 million).

prostitution-purchase.name: Prostitution (buying sex)
prostitution-purchase.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison, a fine of up to KRW 3 million, short-term detention, or a petty fine
prostitution-purchase.law: Act on the Punishment of Arrangement of Commercial Sex Acts, Article 21(1)

options.disabled: With a person with a disability

education.label: Do you agree to attend the repeat-prevention program for sex buyers?

tiers.note: For buying sex abroad, a formal trial is considered if there are 3 or more prostitution records, including those in Korea.
For buying sex from a person with a disability, a suspension of indictment conditional on education is, as a rule, not given.
For buying sex abroad, a summary fine is the rule even for a first offense.
For a first offense, a suspension of indictment conditional on completing the repeat-prevention program for sex buyers (the 'John School'), or referral as a prostitution protection case, is usual.

notes: If you agree to the program but do not complete it, the investigation restarts and the case is handled with a fine or similar.

prostitution-brokering.name: Arranging prostitution (running an establishment, etc.)
prostitution-brokering.statutory: Arranging: up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million; arranging as a business: up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 70 million
prostitution-brokering.law: Act on the Punishment of Arrangement of Commercial Sex Acts, Article 19

options.manager: Manager or similar, involved in managing staff or operations
options.recruiter: Recruited or introduced people for prostitution for payment, or leased the building

staff.label: Number of female employees hired
staff.help: Leave it at 0 if you were not the owner.

priors.label: Prior punishment of the same type

tiers.note: With 5 or more employees, 1 year or more of operation (or criminal proceeds of KRW 100 million or more), 2 or more prior records of the same type, or while on a suspended sentence for the same crime, detention is the rule.
Even a first offense of simple arranging may go to a formal trial if there is a risk of repeat offending.
An ordinary employee may be handled with a summary fine.

notes: Unless the case is very minor, a fine is requested together with a prison sentence, and money earned from prostitution is confiscated or collected.
For arranging prostitution abroad, the request is, as a rule, increased by 1/2.
Detention requires a legal ground such as a risk of fleeing or destroying evidence, so many cases proceed without detention even when they meet this standard.

child-prostitution-purchase.name: Buying sex from a child or juvenile
child-prostitution-purchase.statutory: 1 to 10 years in prison or a fine of KRW 20 million to 50 million (increased by up to 1/2 if the victim is under 16)
child-prostitution-purchase.law: Act on the Protection of Children and Youth against Sex Offenses, Article 13(1)

record.label: Do you have a prior record of the same type?

bad.label: Are there circumstances that make the offense especially bad, such as perverse acts?

tiers.note: If the other person was under 16, it is a repeat offense, or the offense is especially bad, detention is considered.
How it happened, how many times and the other person's age are considered, but as a rule the case goes to a formal trial.

notes: To prevent repeat offending, an order to attend lectures or a sexual violence treatment program is requested together with the sentence.
A person is a child or juvenile until January 1 of the year in which they turn 19.
Detention requires a legal ground such as a risk of fleeing or destroying evidence, so many cases proceed without detention even when they meet this standard.

adult-ent-prostitution.name: Arranging prostitution at an adult entertainment establishment
adult-ent-prostitution.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
adult-ent-prostitution.law: Act on the Regulation of Amusement Businesses Affecting Public Morals, Article 10(1)

priors.label: Prior punishment of the same type

tiers.note: If it is a repeat offense and a juvenile was involved, detention is considered.

notes: This is arranging prostitution at an adult entertainment establishment such as a karaoke room, entertainment bar or lodging business.

theft.name: Theft
theft.statutory: Up to 6 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 10 million

aggravated.label: Was it done by 2 or more people together, by entering someone's home, professionally like pickpocketing, or repeatedly?

prior.label: Do you have a prior conviction of the same type (theft)?

recovered.label: Did you return the stolen goods or pay for the damage?

youth.label: Is the offender a juvenile (under 19) or a student?

tiers.note: Theft by several people together, with entry into a home or a weapon, or done professionally or repeatedly, may lead to investigation in detention.
With a prior conviction of the same type or considerable damage, a formal trial is usual.
For a first offense where the stolen goods were recovered, or for a juvenile or student, a suspension of indictment is possible.

notes: Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

night-burglary.name: Night-time burglary (theft after entering a home at night)

aggravated.label: Was it done by 2 or more people together, with a weapon, or repeatedly?

prior.label: Do you have a prior conviction of the same type (theft)?

recovered.label: Did you return the stolen goods or pay for the damage?

youth.label: Is the offender a juvenile (under 19) or a student?

tiers.note: If it was done by several people together, with a weapon, or repeatedly, investigation in detention may be considered.
This crime has no fine option, so if charged, the case goes to a formal trial.
For a first offense where the stolen goods were recovered, or for a juvenile or student, a suspension of indictment is possible.

notes: This is entering someone's home or building at night and stealing.
Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

special-theft.name: Special theft

repeat.label: Was it repeated several times, or done in a professional way?

prior.label: Do you have a prior conviction of the same type (theft)?

recovered.label: Did you return the stolen goods or pay for the damage?

youth.label: Is the offender a juvenile (under 19) or a student?

tiers.note: If it was repeated or professional, or there is a prior conviction of the same type, investigation in detention may be considered.

Acting jointly with 2 or more people or carrying a weapon is itself treated as serious, so detention is more likely than for ordinary theft. This crime has no fine option, so if charged, the case goes to a formal trial.
For a juvenile or student's first offense where the stolen goods were recovered, a suspension of indictment is possible.

notes: This is stealing with 2 or more people together, while carrying a weapon, or by breaking a door or wall at night to get in.
Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

p2-lost-property-embezzlement.name: Embezzlement of lost property
p2-lost-property-embezzlement.statutory: Up to 1 year in prison, a fine of up to KRW 3 million, or a petty fine
notes: This is picking up a lost item or something out of its owner's possession and keeping it instead of returning it.

stolen-goods.name: Acquiring stolen goods
stolen-goods.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 15 million

business.label: Was it repeated like a business, or is there a prior conviction for the same?

known.label: Did you already trade with or know the person who stole them?

tiers.note: Handling expensive stolen goods as a business, or a repeat offense, may lead to investigation in detention.

notes: This is buying, keeping, moving or selling goods while knowing they were stolen.

fraud.name: Fraud
fraud.statutory: Up to 20 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

amount.label: Amount of damage (money obtained by deception)

agreement.label: Did you repay the damage or settle?

prior.label: Have you received a suspended sentence or heavier for the same crime within the last 5 years?

planned.label: Was it planned and active from the start?

tiers.note: If the damage is KRW 30,000,000 or more and there is no settlement, there is a recent prior conviction of the same type, or the method was planned, investigation in detention may be considered.
If the damage is KRW 10,000,000 or more and there is no settlement, a formal trial is usual. If you settle during the trial, a suspended sentence may be requested.
Without a settlement, the standard fine is 30% or more of the damage.
With a settlement, the standard fine is 10% or more of the damage.

notes: Under the December 2025 amendment (in force from September 2026) the statutory penalty rose sharply to up to 20 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million, so the actual handling may be heavier than this.
If the damage is KRW 500 million or more, a special law (the Specific Economic Crimes Act) punishes it much more heavily.
Even for a small amount, if repayment is unlikely, a fine close to the full damage may be imposed.
Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

computer-fraud.name: Computer fraud
computer-fraud.statutory: Up to 20 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

notes: This is taking money by entering false or unauthorized information into a computer, mobile phone, etc.
From September 2026 the statutory penalty rose sharply to up to 20 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million, so the actual handling may be heavier than this.
If the damage is KRW 500 million or more, a special law (the Specific Economic Crimes Act) punishes it much more heavily.
Even for a small amount, if repayment is unlikely, a fine close to the full damage may be imposed.
Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

voice-phishing-member.name: Taking part in voice phishing (fraud)
voice-phishing-member.statutory: Fraud: up to 20 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (3 years or more in prison for a fixed term if the damage is KRW 500 million or more; life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison if KRW 5 billion or more)
voice-phishing-member.law: Criminal Act, Article 347; Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Economic Crimes, Article 3

options.member: Other participation (collecting, withdrawing or delivering cash, recruiting bank accounts, call-center work, etc.)

This standard requests a heavy sentence even for a simple participant. It may be heavier depending on the damage and degree of involvement.

notes: Voice phishing is classified as a crime for which an actual prison term is sought, and the request is increased.
This standard was set when the maximum penalty for fraud was 10 years. The December 2025 amendment (in force from September 2026) raised the maximum to 20 years, so the actual request may be heavier.
Actual sentences are often lower than the request, and how you became involved, compensation for the damage and cooperation with the investigation are taken into account.
If you handed over a bank account or debit card, see the 'Lending or selling bank accounts (transferring access media)' item.

phone-scam-account.name: Lending or selling bank accounts (transferring or lending access media)
phone-scam-account.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million
phone-scam-account.law: Electronic Financial Transactions Act, Articles 49(4) and 6(3)

priors.label: Prior punishment of the same type

linked.label: Did you hand them directly to a voice phishing ring, or did the accounts cause damage of KRW 10 million or more?

tiers.note: Dealing in accounts used for voice phishing, as a rule, leads to a request for a prison sentence at a formal trial. For an especially minor first offense, a fine (around KRW 3 million for 1 to 10 accounts, KRW 5 million for 11 to 20) is sometimes requested.

notes: If you knew the accounts were used for voice phishing, you may also be investigated for aiding fraud.
After a 2020 amendment, the statutory penalty rose (previously up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million).

efin-access-forgery.name: Forging or altering access media
efin-access-forgery.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million (both may be imposed together)

tiers.sentence: 1 year 6 months or more in prison
tiers.note: For this crime, investigation in detention is considered as a rule and a prison sentence is requested at a formal trial. When a fine is requested, it is at the level of KRW 5 million or more.

notes: Attempts are also punished.

card-misuse.name: Using a lost or stolen credit card
card-misuse.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million
card-misuse.law: Credit Finance Business Act (여신전문금융업법), Article 70(1)(3) and (4)

options.stolen: Stole it, took it by force or got it by deception

settled.label: Did you repay the amount used, deposit it with the court, or settle?

tiers.sentence: 1 year 6 months or more in prison
tiers.note: If punished together with theft, robbery, etc., 6 months to 1 year is added.
A fine equal to the amount used.
Repaying or depositing the money may reduce it to about half of the amount used.

notes: Stealing or picking up the card itself (theft or embezzlement of lost property) and buying goods with it (fraud) may also be at issue.

new-insurance-fraud.name: Insurance fraud
new-insurance-fraud.statutory: Up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million / insurance money of KRW 500 million or more but less than KRW 5 billion: 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term / KRW 5 billion or more: life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison
new-insurance-fraud.law: Special Act on the Prevention of Insurance Fraud, Articles 8 and 11

options.u5b: KRW 500 million or more but less than KRW 5 billion
options.u30b: KRW 5 billion or more but less than KRW 30 billion

circ.help: Settlement or the victim not wanting punishment, compensation for the harm, sincere remorse and a first offense are mitigating; planning, serious harm and prior convictions of the same type are aggravating.

tiers.sentence: 16 to 30 years in prison (life imprisonment may also be considered)
1 year 8 months to 5 years in prison

notes: This is deliberately causing or exaggerating an accident to deceive an insurance company and receive insurance money, or have someone else receive it. Attempts are also punished.
People who arrange, encourage or advertise insurance fraud are punished with the same penalty.
Returning the insurance money is a mitigating factor, but it does not by itself avoid punishment.

aggravated-fraud-500m.name: Fraud, embezzlement or breach of trust under the Specific Economic Crimes Act (KRW 500 million or more)
aggravated-fraud-500m.statutory: Gain of KRW 500 million or more but less than KRW 5 billion: 3 years or more in prison for a fixed term / KRW 5 billion or more: life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison (a fine up to the amount of the gain may be imposed as well)
aggravated-fraud-500m.law: Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Economic Crimes, Article 3(1)

amount.label: Amount of damage (gain)
amount.help: The total obtained through fraud, extortion, embezzlement or breach of trust.

notes: Investigation in detention and a formal trial are the rule.
How much of the damage has been made good (repayment or settlement) and how the crime happened weigh heavily in both the request and the sentence.
Detention requires a legal ground such as a risk of fleeing or destroying evidence, so many cases proceed without detention even when they meet this standard.

embezzlement.name: Embezzlement
embezzlement.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 15 million

agreement.label: Did you repay the damage or settle?

prior.label: Have you received a suspended sentence or heavier for the same crime within the last 5 years?

planned.label: Was it planned and active from the start?

With a settlement, the standard fine is 10% or more of the amount embezzled.

notes: If the amount of embezzlement or breach of trust is KRW 500 million or more, a special law (the Specific Economic Crimes Act) punishes it much more heavily.
Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

occupational-embezzlement.name: Occupational embezzlement
occupational-embezzlement.statutory: Up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 30 million

agreement.label: Did you repay the damage or settle?

prior.label: Have you received a suspended sentence or heavier for the same crime within the last 5 years?

planned.label: Was it planned and active from the start?

If the amount embezzled is KRW 10,000,000 or more and there is no settlement, a formal trial is usual. If you settle during the trial, a suspended sentence may be requested.

notes: If the amount of embezzlement or breach of trust is KRW 500 million or more, a special law (the Specific Economic Crimes Act) punishes it much more heavily.

extortion.name: Extortion
extortion.statutory: Up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million

bad.label: Is it a bad case, such as by an organized gang member or a fake journalist?

prior.label: Have you received a suspended sentence for the same crime within the last 5 years?

oneTime.label: Was it a small amount received once, on impulse?

tiers.note: If the total extorted is KRW 10,000,000 or more or the offense is bad, investigation in detention may be considered.
A formal trial is the rule.
A small amount received once on impulse is sometimes handled with a fine.

notes: Juveniles are, as a rule, sent to the juvenile division without detention, but repeated offenses around a school may lead to detention.
Property crimes between family members (relatives) can be punished only if the victim files a complaint.

methamphetamine.name: Methamphetamine: use, possession or dealing
methamphetamine.statutory: Up to 10 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 100 million (increased by up to 1/2 if habitual; life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison if given or sold to a minor)
methamphetamine.law: Act on the Control of Narcotics, etc., Articles 60(1)(2) and 4(1)

options.use: Use or possession (for your own use)
options.sale: Buying, selling, brokering or handing to others

tiers.note: Dealing or using methamphetamine leads, as a rule, to investigation in detention and a formal trial.
For a first offense of simple use with a willingness to rehabilitate, the usual handling standard is a suspension of indictment conditional on treatment (or education).

notes: More dangerous drugs such as LSD are treated more heavily, and medical drugs such as propofol or sleeping pills more lightly.

Bringing methamphetamine in from abroad or making it is much heavier (life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison), and if the value is large, the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes applies.
Detention requires a legal ground such as a risk of fleeing or destroying evidence, so many cases proceed without detention even when they meet this standard.

cannabis.name: Cannabis: smoking, possession or dealing
cannabis.statutory: Smoking or possession: up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million / dealing or brokering: 1 year or more in prison for a fixed term
cannabis.law: Act on the Control of Narcotics, etc., Articles 61(1)(4) and (6) and 59(1)(7)

options.smoke: Smoking or possession (for your own use)
options.grow: Growing it to sell, or growing a large amount

For a first offense of simple smoking with a willingness to rehabilitate, the usual handling standard is a suspension of indictment conditional on treatment (or education).

notes: Giving it to a minor or smoking together with a minor is punished heavily with 1 year or more in prison.
Detention requires a legal ground such as a risk of fleeing or destroying evidence, so many cases proceed without detention even when they meet this standard.

drug-narcotic-use.name: Narcotics (cocaine, etc.): use

tiers.note: Because the offense is serious, investigation in detention is considered as a rule.

notes: For simple use with a willingness to rehabilitate, a suspension of indictment conditional on treatment or education is sometimes given.

drug-narcotic-possession.name: Narcotics: possession or giving/receiving; heroin: possession or use
drug-narcotic-possession.statutory: 1 year or more in prison for a fixed term
drug-narcotic-possession.law: Act on the Control of Narcotics, etc., Article 59(1)(3) and (9)

tiers.note: Because the offense is serious, investigation in detention is considered as a rule.

notes: If the value of the narcotics is KRW 5 million or more, the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes punishes it more heavily.

drug-narcotic-trade.name: Narcotics (cocaine, heroin, etc.): import/export, manufacture or dealing
drug-narcotic-trade.statutory: Life imprisonment or 5 years or more in prison

labor-unpaid-wages.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 50 million

options.t1: Unpaid amount less than KRW 50 million
options.t2: Unpaid amount KRW 50 million or more but less than KRW 100 million
options.t3: Unpaid amount KRW 100 million or more

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: Compare circumstances such as a settlement, remorse or a first offense with aggravating ones such as the scale of harm or prior convictions, and choose.

tiers.sentence: 8 months to 1 year 4 months in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
Up to 1 year 4 months in prison
2 years 4 months to 5 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison

notes: It cannot be punished if the workers do not want punishment (not punishable against their wishes). This does not apply, however, if an employer whose name was published for unpaid wages fails to pay again during the publication period.
Most cases end with a fine or no punishment once the unpaid amount is paid or a settlement is reached.

new-minimum-wage.name: Paying less than the minimum wage
new-minimum-wage.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 20 million (both may be imposed)
new-minimum-wage.law: Minimum Wage Act, Articles 28(1) and 6(1) and (2)

options.u100m: KRW 50 million or more but less than KRW 100 million

circ.label: Circumstances
circ.help: Settlement or the victim not wanting punishment, compensation for the harm, sincere remorse and a first offense are mitigating; planning, serious harm and prior convictions of the same type are aggravating.

tiers.sentence: 2 years 4 months to 3 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
1 year 4 months to 3 years in prison
Up to 1 year 4 months in prison
8 months to 1 year 4 months in prison

notes: This is paying less than the minimum wage, or cutting existing wages on the ground of the minimum wage.
Paying the underpaid wages is a mitigating factor. It is often at issue together with unpaid wages (Labor Standards Act).

customs-smuggling-import.name: Smuggling imports (importing without declaration or declaring different goods)
customs-smuggling-import.statutory: Up to 5 years in prison, or a fine up to 10 times the customs duty or the cost of the goods, whichever is higher

tiers.note: A fine equal to 10% of the market price of the smuggled goods is requested as well.
20% or more of the cost of the goods.

notes: If the cost of the goods is KRW 200 million or more, the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes applies.
Smuggled goods are always confiscated or their value collected, and customs usually files an accusation if the cost of the goods is KRW 20 million or more.

customs-contraband.name: Importing or exporting prohibited goods (smuggling)
customs-contraband.statutory: Up to 7 years in prison or a fine of up to KRW 70 million

options.danger: Goods harming public safety, such as weapons or counterfeit money
options.obscene: Goods harming public morals, such as obscene material

tiers.note: Small-scale cases involving obscene material and the like may lead to a requested fine.

notes: Smuggling drugs is punished more heavily under the Act on the Control of Narcotics, etc.

customs-smuggled-goods.name: Acquiring, transferring, transporting or storing smuggled goods
customs-smuggled-goods.statutory: Up to 3 years in prison or a fine up to the cost of the goods

tiers.note: A fine equal to 10% of the market price of the smuggled goods is requested as well.
20% or more of the cost of the goods, and it may go up depending on the method.
